Structurally, it forms part of the complex combinatorial matrices of the *Paṭṭhāna*, investigating conditional relations by pairing the *sanidassana* triad (*sanidassanattika*, the triad of states with visible form) with the feeling triad and subsequent triads (*vedanāttikādi*) [SuttaCentral].
